nodes.title: Decoupled Drupal Homepage

heroDescription.processed: Create blazing-fast websites with the power of Drupal's content management and Next.js's modern frontend capabilities.

nodes.featuresSubtitle: The best of both worlds: enterprise CMS meets modern frontend

description.processed: Drupal's enterprise-grade content management with flexible content modeling and powerful editing tools.
Next.js delivers blazing fast page loads with automatic code splitting and optimized rendering.
Built-in security features protect your content with role-based access control and secure APIs.
Modern development workflow with GraphQL APIs, TypeScript support, and hot reloading.
React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and GraphQL - the tools developers love to use.
Deploy to edge networks worldwide for sub-second page loads anywhere on the planet.

ctaDescription.processed: Start building your next project with Decoupled Drupal. Import your content model, customize your frontend, and deploy in minutes.
